integrity: Proof stated for all primes and every bi-infinite configuration; executable checks four groups of orders eight and 27. Embedded files include complete standalone executable and scientific review.
scientific_limitations: Only surjective group-endomorphism cellular automata on a one-dimensional full shift with nonabelian alphabet order p cubed; does not assert least exponent for each map or classify non-surjective rules. Finite tests are corroborative, not proof, and priority is not independently certified.
title: Shift-power rigidity for surjective cellular automata on nonabelian groups of order \(p^3\)
